company.name: Atopile
company.shortDescription: Atopile is a software company that develops tools for crafting electronic circuit board designs using code.
company.description: Atopile develops tools for crafting electronic circuit board designs using code. By replacing the traditional point-and-click schematic interface with code, they bring software development methodologies such as reuse, validation, and automation into the realm of electronics.

productsAndServices.description: A domain-specific language for describing electronic circuit designs with code, including components, interfaces, units, tolerances, and constraints.
productsAndServices.name: ato Language

productsAndServices.description: A command-line tool that compiles ato code to update PCB designs, manage dependencies, and generate manufacturing files.
productsAndServices.name: ato Compiler

productsAndServices.description: An embedded tool to generate ato code templates for electronic components, supporting JLCPCB parts and manufacturer data.
productsAndServices.name: Component Creation Tool

productsAndServices.description: A system to find, install, manage, and synchronize reusable ato code modules and dependencies for circuit design projects.
productsAndServices.name: Package Management System

productsAndServices.description: Integration with KiCad to generate, open, and synchronize PCB layout files from ato code, including a KiCad plugin for layout assistance.
productsAndServices.name: Layout Integration with KiCad

productsAndServices.description: Guidance and tools for using git version control and CI pipelines to manage, build, test, and validate circuit design projects.
productsAndServices.name: Version Control and Continuous Integration Support
